agent.title: Agent

agent.greeting: Tell me what you want to create. I will pick and set the model, LoRAs, prompt, size and more. You can also ask me how to use the app, or what an extension does.
agent.suggestion.anime: An anime girl standing on a beach at sunset
agent.setup.intro: To use the agent, choose which AI to use and sign in. A browser opens for the sign-in. After that, just describe what you want and it sets the prompt, model, LoRAs, parameters and graph. It also answers questions about using the app and about extensions.
agent.setup.waiting: Sign in to {name} in the browser…
agent.setup.notInstalled: The {name} command was not found on this PC. Install it first.
agent.session.empty: No chats yet. Once you send a message, the chat is kept here.

agent.ask.resultsButton: Ask the AI about these results

agent.permission.title: The AI wants to read your pictures or prompts
agent.permission.gallery: What it reads: the list of pictures in the gallery, with their prompts
agent.permission.image: What it reads: how one picture was made (prompts, model, settings)
agent.permission.prompts: What it reads: the prompt and negative prompt of the Generate tab
agent.permission.comicPage: What it reads: a picture of a page of the open comic (the drawn panels, balloons and sound effects)
agent.permission.hint: Whether to ask each time can be changed on the Generation tab of Settings.
agent.setup.openai: Connect Ollama, LM Studio or another OpenAI-compatible server
agent.endpoint.title: Connect a server
agent.endpoint.intro: Connect an AI server that runs on this PC or on your network (Ollama, LM Studio and others that offer an OpenAI-compatible API). The app asks the server and runs the app's tools (changing settings and editors) itself, so the model must support tool calls.
agent.endpoint.addressHint: Most end with /v1. Ollama's default is http://127.0.0.1:11434/v1.
agent.endpoint.keyHint: Stored encrypted on this PC and sent only to this server. Servers on this PC usually need none.
agent.endpoint.keySaved: A key is saved (leave empty to keep it)
agent.endpoint.keyRemoved: The saved key is removed when you press Use this server
agent.endpoint.modelsFound: {count} models found. Choose one from the list or type a name.
agent.endpoint.modelsNone: The model list could not be read. Type the model's name. ({reason})
agent.endpoint.warn.invalid: Enter an address that starts with http:// or https://.
agent.endpoint.warn.http: This address is outside this PC and does not use https. Everything sent, including prompts and the key, travels unencrypted.
agent.endpoint.warn.remote: The server is outside this PC. What the AI reads (prompts and picture details, when you allow it) is sent to that server.
agent.endpoint.result.modelMissing: The server does not have this model.
agent.endpoint.result.toolsOk: This model can call the app's tools.
agent.endpoint.result.toolsNo: This model cannot use the app's tools: {reason}
agent.endpoint.result.toolsUnchecked: Tool calls could not be checked: {reason}
agent.endpoint.tools.unknown: Tool calls not checked yet (Test connection checks them)
agent.endpoint.tools.supported: This model can use the app's tools
agent.endpoint.tools.unsupported: This model cannot use the app's tools: {reason}
agent.endpoint.tools.unsupportedHint: Choose another model that supports tool calls, or fix the server (for example its context length) and press Test connection.
agent.endpoint.noModels: The model list is not available. Type the model's name in the server settings.
agent.model.endpointHint: The model is part of the server settings. A change is used from the next message.
agent.permission.sentLocal: What it reads is sent to the server on this PC.
agent.permission.sentRemote: What it reads is sent over the network to the server ({host}).
agent.attach.drop: Drop pictures here to attach them
agent.attach.tooMany: You can attach up to {count} pictures
agent.attach.defaultAsk: Write a prompt for making a picture like this one, and fill it in.
